# sonarqube_qualityprofile (Resource)

A quality profile. Destroying a profile that still has child profiles is refused, because SonarQube would delete every descendant along with it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "base" {
  name     = "Company Java"
  language = "java"
  parent   = "Sonar way core" # built-in profile names vary by SonarQube version
}

# Inherits every rule of the base profile.
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "strict" {
  name       = "Company Java strict"
  language   = "java"
  parent     = sonarqube_qualityprofile.base.name
  is_default = true
}

# Rules managed as a backup (exported with "Back up" in the UI). Rules not in
# the file are deactivated; changes made in the UI show up as drift.
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "python" {
  name     = "Company Python"
  language = "py"
  backup   = file("${path.module}/company-python.xml")
}

# A one-time copy, e.g. to start from a built-in profile and tune it with
# sonarqube_qualityprofile_activate_rule.
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "python_experimental" {
  name      = "Company Python experimental"
  language  = "py"
  copy_from = sonarqube_qualityprofile.python.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `language` (String) Language key, e.g. `java`.
- `name` (String) Profile name. Changing it renames the profile in place.

### Optional

- `backup` (String) Rules of the profile as a backup in SonarQube's XML format, as written by *Back up* in the UI or `api/qualityprofiles/backup` (for example `file("profile.xml")`). The profile is restored from it: the rules listed are activated with their settings and every other rule is deactivated. The backup's `<name>` is ignored (the profile's `name` is used) and its `<language>` must match `language`. Terraform reports drift when the profile's rules no longer match; only what the backup sets is compared, so a hand-written backup may omit priorities, impacts or parameters. SonarQube silently skips unknown rules on restore, so the provider fails the apply when a listed rule did not get activated. Do not combine with `sonarqube_qualityprofile_activate_rule` on the same profile.
- `copy_from` (String) Name of a profile of the same language to copy when creating this one: its rules, their settings and its parent. If the source inherits from a profile, set `parent` to that profile, or to another one to re-parent the copy. Only used on creation; changing it to another profile re-creates this one, and adding it to an existing (e.g. imported) profile or removing it changes nothing.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Make this the language's default profile. Unsetting it, or destroying the profile while default, makes the profile that was default before Terraform made this one default the default again, or the built-in profile when that one is unknown or gone.
- `parent` (String) Name of the parent profile to inherit rules from. Changing it re-parents the profile in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Profile key.
- `key` (String) Profile key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = sonarqube_qualityprofile.example
  identity = { language = "java", name = "Company Java" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `language` (String) Language key.
- `name` (String) Profile name.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_qualityprofile.example 'java/Company Java'
```
